title: 第十章 危避锋芒第十一章电厂计划
lines: 第十章：危避锋芒
民国二十五年的上海，秋意已浸透了法租界的梧桐叶。凌峰站在“归燕楼”二楼的窗前，指尖划过微凉的玻璃，望着街对面那辆停了整整三日的黑色轿车。车身上落着薄尘，车窗紧闭，却像一只蛰伏的兽，目光始终黏在餐厅朱红色的门脸上。
“在看什么？”刘佳琪端着一碗刚炖好的银耳羹走进来，鬓角的碎发被她用一根素银簪子别住，衬得眉眼愈发温婉。她顺着凌峰的视线望去，眉头轻轻蹙起，“还是那辆车？”
凌峰转过身，接过白瓷碗，氤氲的热气模糊了他眼底的沉郁：“嗯。第三日了。”
自打七日前青口在餐厅后院显露水晶人形态，帮他们吓退了那伙勒索的地痞后，麻烦便像嗅到血腥味的鲨鱼，接二连三地涌来。先是地痞背后的头目——盘踞在闸北的军阀张旅长，派人送来一张措辞倨傲的“贺帖”，实则是想打探那晚“天降异光”的底细；紧接着，凌峰在去菜市场采买时，总觉得有人在暗处打量，那目光阴冷刺骨，绝非张旅长的人那般粗鄙，倒像是猎人在估量猎物的分量。
青口说过，追踪他们的“星际赏金猎人”擅长伪装，能化作任何人的模样。这个消息像一根细刺，扎在凌峰心头，让他看谁都觉得可疑——擦肩而过的黄包车夫，隔壁洋行的账房先生，甚至是常来送菜的阿婆，都可能在某个瞬间露出非人的獠牙。
“方才账房老李来说，张旅长的副官下午又来了，说晚上要带‘朋友’来吃饭，指定要你作陪。”刘佳琪的声音低了些，指尖无意识地绞着围裙的系带，“我总觉得不对劲，他们怕是醉翁之意不在酒。”
凌峰舀了一勺银耳羹，甜糯的滋味压不住喉咙口的涩意。他放下碗，走到衣架旁取下长衫：“我去趟码头。”
“现在？”刘佳琪抬头看他，“天都快黑了。”
“青口说，赏金猎人的能量波动在码头附近最明显。”凌峰系着衣扣，动作沉稳，“张旅长那边我先避一避，你让老李推说我临时去苏州采买鲜笋，今晚回不来。至于那辆车……”他眼神一凛，“你锁好前后门，别让任何人进来，等我回来。”
刘佳琪知道他的性子，决定的事难更改。她上前帮他理了理衣襟，指尖在他手腕上轻轻捏了一下，那力道里藏着担忧，也藏着笃定：“我等你。万事小心。”
凌峰点点头，转身下楼。穿过大堂时，账房老李正搓着手在柜台前打转，见他出来，急道：“老板，那副官还在门口等着呢……”
“按方才说好的应付。”凌峰拍了拍老李的肩膀，声音压得极低，“看好老板娘，别让任何人上楼。”
老李虽是个普通生意人，却也瞧出这些日子的不寻常，忙不迭点头：“放心，老板！”
凌峰没走正门，从后厨的角门绕了出去。巷子狭窄，堆着些废弃的木箱，墙根处有几只野猫被脚步声惊起，蹿上屋顶时带落几片枯叶。他贴着墙根快步走，眼角的余光瞥见那辆黑色轿车的车门动了一下，似乎有人要下来。
他心一紧，加快脚步拐进另一条岔路。这条路由来是三教九流混杂之地，此刻正是夜市热闹的时候，挑着担子的小贩沿街叫卖，穿短打的苦力扛着货物穿梭，空气中弥漫着炸臭豆腐和劣质烟草的味道。凌峰混在人群里，刻意放慢脚步，脱下长衫搭在臂弯，露出里面打了补丁的短褂，倒像个寻常的帮工。
身后的脚步声若即若离，他不敢回头，只凭着多年在国外练就的敏锐直觉，在迷宫般的巷弄里七拐八绕。穿过一道爬满藤蔓的拱门时，他听见身后传来一声极轻的嗤笑，那笑声不像人声，倒像是金属摩擦玻璃，尖锐得让人头皮发麻。
是赏金猎人！
凌峰心脏猛地一缩，几乎是本能地往前冲。前方是个露天的戏台，今晚正演着《长坂坡》，锣鼓喧天，台下黑压压挤满了人。他想也没想，一头扎进人群里，顺着人流往前挪。
“抓住他！”一个沙哑的声音在身后响起，带着不容错辨的命令口吻。
凌峰眼角余光扫到两个穿着黑色短打的汉子正拨开人群追来，他们的动作快得反常，脚下踩着看戏人的肩膀，却半点声音也没有，显然不是普通人。他咬咬牙，看到戏台侧面有个供演员上下的窄梯，几步冲过去，手脚并用地爬了上去。
后台乱糟糟的，戏服堆了一地，几个扮相的演员正候场，见他闯进来，都吓了一跳。“你是谁？”一个画着红脸的武生呵斥道。
“借过！”凌峰没时间解释，掀开侧面的布帘冲了出去。外面是条僻静的后巷，堆着几捆柴火，尽头是一扇紧锁的铁门。
脚步声越来越近，他甚至能感觉到背后传来一阵刺骨的寒意，像是被毒蛇盯上了。他摸出藏在腰间的玉佩——这枚玉观音如今成了他唯一的依仗，青口说过，只要他意念足够强烈，玉佩能暂时干扰赏金猎人的感知。
他紧紧攥着玉佩，冰凉的触感顺着掌心传来，脑海里只剩下刘佳琪的脸——她在灯下算账的模样，她为他缝补衣衫的模样，她在新婚夜说“往后不管发生什么，我都信你”的模样。一股热流从心底涌上来，顺着手臂注入玉佩。
玉佩突然发出一阵极轻微的震颤，一道几乎看不见的淡蓝色光晕从玉观音的眉眼间散开。身后的脚步声猛地顿住，紧接着传来几声困惑的低吼，似乎在分辨他的方位。
content_en:
Chapter 10: Avoid danger and avoid danger
In Shanghai in the 25th year of the Republic of China, the autumn mood has penetrated the sycamore leaves in the French Concession. Ling Feng stood in front of the window on the second floor of "Guiyan Tower", running his fingertips across the cool glass, looking at the black car across the street that had been parked for three days. There was a thin layer of dust on the car, and the windows were closed, but like a dormant beast, its eyes were always glued to the vermilion door of the restaurant.
"What are you looking at?" Liu Jiaqi walked in with a bowl of freshly stewed white fungus soup. Her broken hair on the temples was pinned with a plain silver hairpin, which made her eyebrows more gentle. She followed Ling Feng's gaze and frowned slightly, "Is it still that car?"
Ling Feng turned around and took the white porcelain bowl. The hot air blurred the gloom in his eyes: "Yes. It's the third day."
Ever since Qingkou revealed his crystalline form in the backyard of the restaurant seven days ago and helped them scare away the gang of extortion gangsters, troubles have been coming one after another like sharks smelling blood. First, the leader behind the gangsters, Brigadier Zhang, a warlord entrenched in Zhabei, sent a "congratulatory note" with arrogant words. In fact, he wanted to find out the details of the "light from the sky" that night. Then, when Ling Feng went to the vegetable market to buy, he always felt that someone was looking at him in the dark, with cold and piercing eyes. It was definitely not as vulgar as Brigadier Zhang's, but more like a hunter assessing the weight of his prey.
Qingkou said that the "interstellar bounty hunter" who was tracking them was good at disguise and could take on the appearance of anyone. This news was like a thin thorn in Ling Feng's heart, making everyone look suspicious to him - the rickshaw driver he passed by, the accounting clerk from the company next door, and even the grandma who often came to deliver food might all show their inhuman fangs at a certain moment.
"Lao Li, the accountant just now, came to tell me that Brigadier Zhang's adjutant came again in the afternoon. He said that he would bring his 'friends' to dinner in the evening and appointed you as his companion." Liu Jiaqi's voice was lowered, and her fingertips unconsciously twisted the tie of her apron. "I always feel that something is wrong. They are afraid that they are drunkards who are not interested in drinking."
Ling Feng took a spoonful of white fungus soup. The sweet and glutinous taste could not suppress the astringency in his throat. He put down the bowl, walked to the hanger and took off his gown: "I'm going to the pier."
"Now?" Liu Jiaqi looked up at him, "It's almost dark."
"Qingkou said that the energy fluctuations of bounty hunters are most obvious near the dock." Ling Feng fastened his clothes and moved calmly, "I will avoid Brigadier Zhang's side first. You asked Lao Li to say that I temporarily went to Suzhou to buy fresh bamboo shoots and won't be able to come back tonight. As for that car..." He looked sharply, "You lock the front and rear doors, don't let anyone in, and wait for me to come back."
Liu Jiaqi knew his temperament and it was difficult to change his decision. She stepped forward to straighten his clothes, and pinched his wrist gently with her fingertips. There was worry and determination hidden in the strength: "I'll wait for you. Be careful in everything."
Ling Feng nodded, turned around and went downstairs. When walking through the lobby, the accountant Lao Li was rubbing his hands in front of the counter. When he saw him coming out, he said anxiously: "Boss, the adjutant is still waiting at the door..."
"We will deal with it as we agreed." Ling Feng patted Lao Li on the shoulder and said in a very low voice, "Watch the boss lady and don't let anyone go upstairs."
Although Lao Li is an ordinary businessman, he also sees that these days are unusual and nods hastily: "Don't worry, boss!"
Ling Feng did not go through the front door, but went out through the corner door of the back kitchen. The alley is narrow, with some abandoned wooden boxes piled up. There are a few wild cats at the base of the wall that are startled by the footsteps, and they drop a few dead leaves when they jump up to the roof. He walked quickly against the wall, and out of the corner of his eye he saw the door of the black car move, as if someone was about to get out.
His heart tightened, and he quickened his pace and turned into another fork in the road. This road was originally a place where people from all walks of life mixed together. At this moment, the night market was busy. Vendors carrying burdens were selling their goods along the street. Coolies in shorts were carrying goods back and forth. The air was filled with the smell of fried stinky tofu and low-quality tobacco. Ling Feng blended into the crowd, deliberately slowed down, took off his long coat and put it on his arms, revealing a patched short coat underneath, looking like an ordinary helper.
He didn't dare to look back as the footsteps behind him seemed to be far away, and he only relied on his keen intuition that he had developed abroad for many years to twist and turn in the maze-like alleys. As he passed through an archway covered with vines, he heard a very light sneer coming from behind. The laughter was not like a human voice, but more like metal rubbing against glass, so sharp that it made people's scalp numb.
Be a bounty hunter!
Ling Feng's heart suddenly shrank and he rushed forward almost instinctively. There is an open-air stage in front, and "Changban Slope" is being performed tonight. The gongs and drums are noisy, and the stage is dark and crowded with people. Without thinking, he dove into the crowd and moved forward with the flow of people.
"Catch him!" A hoarse voice sounded from behind, with an unmistakable command tone.
From the corner of his eye, Ling Feng caught sight of two men in black shorts chasing away from the crowd. Their movements were abnormally fast, and they stepped on the shoulders of theatergoers without making any sound. They were obviously not ordinary people. He gritted his teeth and saw a narrow ladder on the side of the stage for actors to go up and down. He rushed over in a few steps and climbed up on his hands and feet.
The backstage was in a mess, costumes were piled all over the floor, and several costumed actors were waiting. When they saw him barging in, they were all shocked. "Who are you?" A martial artist with a red face yelled.
"Borrowed it!" Ling Feng didn't have time to explain, so he opened the curtain on the side and rushed out. Outside is a secluded back alley, with several bundles of firewood piled up, and at the end is a locked iron door.
The footsteps were getting closer and closer, and he could even feel a biting chill coming from behind, as if he was being stared at by a poisonous snake. He took out the jade pendant hidden in his waist - this jade Guanyin has now become his only support. Qingkou said that as long as his thoughts are strong enough, the jade pendant can temporarily interfere with the bounty hunter's perception.
He clutched the jade pendant tightly, and a cold touch came down his palm. Only Liu Jiaqi's face remained in his mind - the way she looked at settling accounts under the lamp.
